title: Engineering Manager, APAC
desc:
About Monster Energy
Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become on along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.
A Day In The Life
As Engineering Manager, you'll lead the execution of packaging and manufacturing initiatives across the APAC region, driving projects from concept through commercialization. You'll partner with bottlers, co-packers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to deliver new product launches, innovation, capacity expansions, and process improvements. This role is responsible for ensuring projects are executed on time, within budget, and in compliance with Monster Energy's quality and packaging standards. You'll provide technical leadership, support packaging development and line trials, standardize specifications and processes, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and operational performance across the supply network.
The Impact You'll Make
Develop and maintain relationships with all bottlers, co-packers and packaging suppliers to ensure consistency among standards and processes.
Provide technical support on projects with regards to packaging development for new launches, innovation, new site expansion, specification standardization, sustainability, etc.
Attend line trials and plant start-ups at co-packers and suppliers to ensure integrity of MEC product.
Develop and maintain audit sheet, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, equipment specification, packaging standards.
Assist in responding to customer complaints or inquires, develop action plans, Input of palletization details, weights and measures information within SAP system.
Travel to all bottlers, co-packers and suppliers to evaluate processes and to ensure integrity of MEC product.
Manage and update the current and archived container and packaging files.
Who You Are
Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of Engineering or related field of study
Additional Experience Desired: More than 7 years of experience in manufacturing and packaging
Additional Experience Desired: More than 7 years of experience in beverage industry
Computer Skills Desired: Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Project, and Outlook
Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Fluent English communication skills required, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders across the APAC region, including bottlers, co-packers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams.
